We go back home by taxi.
The students come out of school.

sentences.text: أَنَا فِي الْمَحَطَّةِ، أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَطَارِ بِسَيَّارَةِ أُجْرَةٍ.
sentences.gloss: I’m at the station; I’m going to the airport by taxi.
On Friday we go to the market.

sentences.text: يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ لَا نَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوقِ.
sentences.gloss: On Friday we don’t go to the market.
On Saturday I stay at home.

sentences.text: يَعُودُ أَبِي مِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَسَاءَ الْخَمِيسِ.
sentences.gloss: My father comes back from work on Thursday evening.

sentences.text: فِي نِهَايَةِ الْأُسْبُوعِ نُسَافِرُ إِلَى الْقَرْيَةِ.
sentences.gloss: At the weekend we go to the village.
I drink coffee in the morning.
I drink tea in the evening.
The children come back from school at noon.
I drink tea in the afternoon.
I don’t drink coffee at night.
Where are you now? (to a woman)
Are you staying at home today?
My father was at work yesterday.
I always drink coffee in the morning.
We sometimes eat at the restaurant.
I often go to the market.
I usually go to work by bus.
We go to school every day.
On Sunday morning I go to the market.
Is your birthday in February? (to a woman)
Spring is in March and April.
I’m travelling to Egypt in April.
We go to the village in May.
Summer is in June, July and August.
The holidays are in June and July.
We go back to school in September.

sentences.text: تَعُودُ أُخْتِي إِلَى الْجَامِعَةِ فِي سِبْتِمْبِرَ.
sentences.gloss: My sister goes back to university in September.

sentences.text: الْخَرِيفُ فِي تِشْرِينَ الْأَوَّلِ وَتِشْرِينَ الثَّانِي.
sentences.gloss: Autumn is in October and November.
I go back home in November.

sentences.text: الشِّتَاءُ فِي كَانُونَ الْأَوَّلِ وَكَانُونَ الثَّانِي وَشُبَاطَ.
sentences.gloss: Winter is in December, January and February.
When is your birthday? — In December.
My brother comes back in February.
We don’t drink tea after lunch.
You stay at home until the evening.

sentences.text: هَلْ تَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ حَتَّى الْمَسَاءِ؟
sentences.gloss: Do you stay at home until the evening?
I’ve been waiting since the morning.
I’ve been waiting for the bus for an hour.
I’ve been here for a week.
He has been in the city for a year.
I don’t drink coffee during work.
The train arrives in five minutes.
There are twelve months in a year.
There are seven days in a week.
There are sixty minutes in an hour.
The holidays are in the summer.
Every year we go to the village.
Every month I buy a book.
